(module g3AltDriver                                :x [main] :i [(asl-forms/repair :a rep)])

; (:m)                                                    
fn printAll xs: (List String) sentinel: String -> Int64
  (mt (listHead xs)
    ((none) 0)
    ((some x) (do (println sentinel) (println x) (printAll (optionOr (listTail xs) (list)) sentinel))))

; (:m)             
fn main args: (List String) -> (Result Int64 String)
  (let [(inFile (optionOr (listGet args 0) ""))
        (lang (optionOr (listGet args 1) "asl"))
        (sentinel (optionOr (listGet args 2) "G3ALT"))]
    (mt (fileReadString inFile)
      ((err e) (ok 3))
      ((ok text)
        (let [(alts (rep/repairAlternatives text lang))]
          (do (println (str "(:alts " (stringFromInt64 (listLength alts)) ")"))
              (printAll alts sentinel)
              (println sentinel)
              (ok 0)))))))
